_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

From the Mountains#000.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs om fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#000.dst: ¡Mmf! ¡Humfano! ¡Mi cafsa arfde! ¡Busfca ayufda, el fuefgo no pafra!
From the Mountains#000.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#001.src: It's impossible to understand what language this man's speaking, but he's pointing to the house behind him. Is there something that can translate, maybe?
From the Mountains#001.dst: Es imposible entender qué idioma habla este hombre, pero señala la casa que tiene detrás. ¿Habrá algo que pueda traducir?

From the Mountains#002.src: Arnod keeps on pointing at his house. Maybe he needs something that's in there?
From the Mountains#002.dst: Arnod no deja de señalar su casa. ¿Será que necesita algo que hay ahí dentro?

From the Mountains#003.src: Arnod takes his dentures, and slides them back in his mouth.
From the Mountains#003.dst: Arnod coge su dentadura y se la vuelve a meter en la boca.

From the Mountains#004.src: Go, human! Find someone who can help! I'm not going to wait for my house to be burnt to a crisp!
From the Mountains#004.dst: ¡Ve, humano! ¡Busca a alguien que pueda ayudar! ¡No voy a esperar a que mi casa quede achicharrada!

From the Mountains#005.src: Well, hey there humie! Nice to see ya've come to our little corner of the province.
From the Mountains#005.dst: ¡Vaya, hola, humanito! Me alegra que te hayas pasado por nuestro rincón de la provincia.

From the Mountains#006.src: Can't say there's much here, exactly... Well. Except for the... clock tower.
From the Mountains#006.dst: No se puede decir que haya mucho aquí, la verdad… Bueno. Salvo la… torre del reloj.

From the Mountains#007.src: Oh, that's somethin' alright. Been abandoned my whole life, and as far as I can tell that big 'ol clock's up there's broken.
From the Mountains#007.dst: Oh, eso sí que es algo. Lleva abandonada toda mi vida y, por lo que veo, ese reloj grande de arriba está roto.

From the Mountains#008.src: But... Well, here's the strangest thing. I swear, if ya head out there at night, you can hear some sort of ticking noise...
From the Mountains#008.dst: Pero… bueno, aquí viene lo más raro. Te juro que, si vas por allí de noche, se oye una especie de tictac…

From the Mountains#009.src: As far as I can tell, it ain't comin' from the tower. No, it's comin' from somewhere below...
From the Mountains#009.dst: Por lo que puedo distinguir, no viene de la torre. No, viene de algún sitio de abajo…

From the Mountains#010.src: ... Oh, I've rambled long enough, I think. I hope ya enjoy your stay, humie. It's real nice out here.
From the Mountains#010.dst: …Ah, creo que ya he divagado bastante. Espero que disfrutes de tu estancia, humanito. Esto de aquí está muy bien.

From the Mountains#011.src: Hm...where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#011.dst: Hmm… ¿y dónde voy a encontrar ayuda ahora…? ¿Eh? Tú eres de esos tipos humanos, ¿verdad? ¿No tendrás-
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there... Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#012.dst: Bah, ya lo veré al llegar. Ah, ¿qué hago yo por aquí? Sí, supongo que no me parezco a lo que sueles ver. Bueno, soy un enano.

From the Mountains#013.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh...that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#013.dst: …y donde hay humo, hay fuego. Esto es, eh… esto se parece ya un poco más a mi tierra, y estoy bastante seguro de que no debería.
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-lighting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#014.dst: ¿Esa es la casa? Bien, veré qué puedo hacer. Quizá no logre apagarlo, pero si se vuelve a encender, entonces quizá...
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#015.src: Hm...didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#015.dst: Hmm… no pensaba que llegarían tan lejos, pero tendría sentido si…
From the Mountains#015.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#016.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else are harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#016.dst: Hay un problema de mercado negro en {p}. Lo que no se encuentra en ningún otro sitio se recolecta en las Heights por su alto valor.
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#017.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. We still have work to do.
From the Mountains#017.dst: Ya tengo la carreta reparada y lista, ¿has cogido todos los Flerisi? Ven a la carreta entonces. Aún queda trabajo.
From the Mountains#017.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#018.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fires went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#018.dst: ...oh. Bueno, antes no noté que el fuego llegara TAN lejos. Eso es un problema, ¿verdad?
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#019.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed off cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#019.dst: Te explico: no todos los Flerisi son tan diminutos como estos. Se alimentan de brasas y fuego... Y para causar tanto daño, pues...
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#020.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well...I got a free cart for the ride home. There's a thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#020.dst: Preguntaré a la guardia local si han encontrado a los traficantes. Si se largaron, bueno... tengo una carreta gratis para volver a casa. Allí me esperan asuntos.
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#021.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#023.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#023.dst: ¡Te pfido ayufda! ¡No tenfgo ni idfea de qué pafsa!
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#024.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#024.dst: Encuentra dentro de la casa lo que Arnod quiere.

From the Mountains#025.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#025.dst: ...bueno, eso explica que no ayudaras. Pero, eh, ¿¡el FUEGO ENORME se te pasó por alto!?
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#026.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#026.dst: ¡¡Me da igual quién sea, tráeme ayuda!! Me da igual si lo haces tú o si buscas a alguien, ¡pero alguien tiene que ocuparse de este fuego loco que se vuelve a encender!
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#027.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#027.dst: Pregunta por {p} si hace falta, ¡pero date prisa ya! ¡Mi casa arderá hasta las cenizas si no te apuras!
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#028.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.
From the Mountains#028.dst: Encuentra a alguien en {p} que pueda ayudarte con el fuego.

From the Mountains#030.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#030.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Se le quema la casa a alguien? Supongo que eso es más urgente que lo mío. ¿Dónde es?
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#031.dst: ¿Ah, ese valle junto a la puerta? Creo que sé cuál dices. Vamos andando. ¿Y qué pasó exactamente?
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said... what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#032.dst: Ah, así que eres mercenario y hallaste la casa de este hombre en llamas. Dijo... ¿qué? ¿Que se reenciende sola? Eso no tiene ningún sentido.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there. Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#033.dst: Bah, ya lo veré al llegar. Ah, ¿qué hago yo por aquí? Sí, supongo que no me parezco a lo que sueles ver. Bueno, soy un enano.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#034.dst: Normalmente vivo en {p}, pasados los cañones del este. Adivina cómo es esa tierra por el nombre.
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#035.dst: Sin entrar en detalles, hay... algunos problemas con cómo se gobierna aquello, y yo intentaba reunir apoyos en {p}.
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#036.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#036.dst: Pues, eh. Bueno, en casa ya me acostumbré a que me echaran a risas, pero no esperaba lo mismo allí, solo que con paredes de cuarzo.
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#037.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#037.dst: Iba a preguntarte si podías ayudarme de algún modo, pero... bueno, el humo se huele desde aquí. Una cosa a la vez.
From the Mountains#037.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#039.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#039.dst: Sí, este fuego no es natural... ¡Diablos, casi parece provocado!
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#042.dst: ¡Ajá! Aquí está el problema. Es solo un pequeño Fleris. Eh, te explico: suelen vivir en las Heights.
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#043.dst: Bastante cariñosos, buenos si aguantas el calor, pero si los alejas de sus montículos se asustan.
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: One fleris could have kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout... there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#044.dst: Un fleris pudo incendiar esta casa una y otra vez, pero con todos los demás destrozos... seguro que hay más de donde vino este.
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#045.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#045.dst: Vamos a hablar con el aldeano de fuera. Quizá vio adónde fueron los otros, o de dónde vinieron.
From the Mountains#045.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#046.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#046.dst: Señor, descubrí por qué su casa se reencendía y lo resolví, pero dígame, ¿ha visto por aquí alguna cosa viscosa que se moviera?
From the Mountains#046.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#047.dst: Ehm, no lo sé muy bien. ¡He intentado apagar mi casa tantas veces que no me he fijado en nada!
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#048.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#048.dst: ¡Recuerdo haber visto algo parecido a alquitrán goteando desde las montañas detrás de mi casa, y ya está!
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#049.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#049.dst: Me parece una pista bastante sólida. Veamos qué ocurre en lo alto de la cresta. Consulta tu libro si necesitas indicaciones.
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#050.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.
From the Mountains#050.dst: Ve al sendero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y súbelo hasta la cima de la montaña.

From the Mountains#051.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#051.dst: Hm, escalas bastante rápido. Creía que te adelantaría. Bueno, esto se parece a la zona quemada del valle... ¡Hm! Lo suponía.
From the Mountains#051.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#052.dst: Solo se me ocurre una razón para que haya tantos Flerisi por aquí... Si esa carreta está reforzada, entonces...
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#053.dst: Bah, lo sabía. ¡Traficantes! Y además incompetentes, ya que no supieron retener a los bichos.
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#055.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#055.dst: Los Flerisi son una de esas cosas. En las Heights los tienen como mascotas. Son bastante amistosos, calientan la casa y no dan mucho trabajo...
From the Mountains#055.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#056.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#056.dst: ...Pero si los sacas de un sitio cálido, lo queman todo. Y pensar- Algunos los usan como armas. No saben dejar las cosas en paz...
From the Mountains#056.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#057.dst: Tendremos que atrapar a estos Flerisi. Toma, coge esta red. Mientras los cazas, repararé la carreta para meterlos luego.
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#058.dst: Captura a todos los Flerisi sueltos y llévaselos a Axelus.

From the Mountains#060.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#060.dst: Tendré a los Flerisi junto a un fuego pequeño para calmarlos, y luego veré si puedo devolverlos a las Heights.
From the Mountains#060.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#061.dst: Por ahora quiero ver si averiguo algo sobre quiénes eran estos traficantes. Veamos si dejaron algo en la parte delantera de la carreta.
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#064.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#064.dst: Me parece que este se está descontrolando. Y encima está justo al lado de ese gran bosque. Puede dar problemas si lo dejamos estar.
From the Mountains#064.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#065.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#065.dst: Tendremos que rastrearlo y someterlo. Ven, sígueme. Cavaré un camino hasta el valle. ¡Mira cómo trabaja un enano!
From the Mountains#065.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#068.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#068.dst: No está mal, ¿eh? En fin, no sé para qué es esa puerta enorme, pero parece que nuestro amigo Fleris la ha requisado para hacer una hoguera.
From the Mountains#068.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#069.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#069.dst: Al menos está más contenido de lo que pensaba, ahí en la cueva, pero aún hay que atraparlo. Tú delante. Voy contigo.
From the Mountains#069.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#070.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#070.dst: ¿Qué dem...?! ¡Ha incendiado a los bichos de la cueva! ¡Aguántalos!
From the Mountains#070.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#071.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#071.dst: ¡Vienen más! ¡Corre al fondo de la cueva!
From the Mountains#071.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#073.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#073.dst: Si los dos nos paramos tardaremos demasiado, ¡y los traficantes podrían volver!
From the Mountains#073.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#074.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#074.dst: Escucha. Yo me encargo de estas cosas y tú vas a por el Fleris. Si es grande como creemos, la pelea irá a mejor- ¡Debería encogerse si lo atacas!
From the Mountains#074.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#075.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#075.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#077.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#077.dst: ¡Uf, sigues de una pieza! Con quemaduras y hollín, pero era de esperar. ¡Y el Fleris sometido! Tengo la red, déjame a mí.
From the Mountains#077.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#078.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#078.dst: Bueno, lo que acabamos de hacer es un trabajo poco agradecido, pero como tantos otros. Salgamos de aquí. Hablamos fuera.
From the Mountains#078.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#079.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#079.dst: Sal de la cueva y habla con Axelus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#080.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#080.dst: Digo que el trabajo es ingrato, pero eso no me detendrá. Gracias por la ayuda, humano- Solo, esto me habría superado.
From the Mountains#080.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#082.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#082.dst: Ah, ¿dónde están mis modales? No me he presentado en todo este rato. Me llamo Axelus. ¿Y tú?
From the Mountains#082.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#083.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#083.dst: {u}, ¿eh? Intentaré recordarlo. Por ahora, toma esta armadura por las molestias. ¡Buen viaje, {u}!
From the Mountains#083.speaker: Axelus
